d067-krishna-youth.identity: Use the D062 provisional youthful Vraja cowherd identity: deep-blue matte skin, serene youthful face, dark wavy hair, restrained peacock feather, yellow dhoti and muted red-orange upper cloth, with ordinary youthful two-arm/two-leg anatomy. The cue is provisional and does not imply D066 art approval. No infant face or proportions.
d067-krishna-youth.anatomy: One face, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet; natural youthful adult proportions.
d067-krishna-youth.iconography: Vraja cowherd youth in yellow dhoti and muted red-orange upper cloth; small restrained peacock feather; flute only when a scene plan explicitly requires it.
d067-krishna-youth.continuity: Use the D062/D066 youthful Krishna identity cue without copying pose, framing or props. One physical Krishna per scene except stanza 6’s explicitly imagined vision, shown as a nonphysical thought-image.
d067-krishna-youth.style: Flat opaque South Indian temple mural, dark drawn contours, painted ochre ornament, no gloss or metallic reflections.

gopikas.identity: Use the existing gopikas character bible: distinct adult women with natural proportions and simple village dress. For every D066 scene, keep them modestly and fully clothed in opaque garments. The clothing-promise verse is represented symbolically; never depict undressing, nudity, exposed bodies, sexualized framing, or a clothing theft in progress.
gopikas.anatomy: Each woman has one face, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet, with ordinary adult proportions and distinct features.
gopikas.continuity: Adult village women in modest opaque garments; distinct people, no cloning or fusion. No fixed individual identity except Radha in stanzas 3 and 7.
gopikas.style: Simple matte village dress in muted mural colors; no palace finery or glossy rendering.

radha.identity: Radha, an adult gopika, distinct from the unnamed group; calm and without pride in stanza 3, later sorrowful after separation in stanza 7.
radha.anatomy: One face, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet, ordinary adult proportions.
radha.continuity: Modest fully opaque village garments. Her identity is a character cue only; no eroticized framing or intimate contact.
